entry.name: thresh
entry.digest: Combine numbers, symbols and lists when received close together
entry.description: Collects items into a list if they appear within a certain specifiable amount of time. Each time an item arrives, the time is reset.

arguments.name: threshold
arguments.description: Sets an initial value for the threshold time. If no argument is present, the initial value is 10 milliseconds.

messages.name: anything
messages.description: Numbers, symbols and lists are combined into a list if received within a certain time of each other. When the time between incoming values is greater than the specified threshold, the list is sent out the outlet, and a new list is started.

messages.name: float
messages.description: In left inlet: Numbers, symbols and lists are combined into a list if received within a certain time of each other. When the time between incoming values is greater than the specified threshold, the list is sent out the outlet, and a new list is started.In right inlet: The number is stored as the time, in milliseconds, to wait before sending out the compiled list of numbers. If no new number is received in the left inlet within that time, the list is sent out and a new list is started.
